title: AakarFORM 8.58 · Mass select sketches, all or one by one

courses.title: Select many sketches: all at once or one by one
courses.objective: Select every sketch shape in one click, only the circles, only shapes of the same size or plane — or step through them with Keep / Skip.

steps.title: Make several sketches
instructions: Four circles (two sizes) and a square are built, each in its own sketch.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step.

steps.title: Select one, then All
instructions: Click one shape: the bar shows All (5) and 1 by 1.
Click All (5): every sketch shape is selected.
steps.why: All is one click from any selected shape.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step.

steps.title: Only some
instructions: Click More… (Select many) and choose All circles (4) or Same size as this (2). Use Add / Remove to refine.
steps.why: The choices come from the shapes in your model.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step.

steps.title: One by one
instructions: Press ‘1 by 1’ next to All circles.
In the step panel: Keep ✓ (Enter) keeps and moves on, Skip ▶ (→) moves on, ◀ goes back; Space toggles.
Press Done: everything kept is selected.
steps.why: You decide per shape; Esc cancels and restores the old selection.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step.

steps.title: Use the selection
instructions: Pull them together, or Delete, or Move… — all selected shapes follow.
steps.why: A multi-selection works with every shape tool.

checkpoint.expected: The action applied to all selected shapes.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step.
